questions.question_text:
A Boolean function
is to be implemented using only 2 × 1 multiplexers, the number of 2 × 1 multiplexers required are ________.
questions.question_html: A Boolean function  is to be implemented using only 2 × 1 multiplexers, the number of 2 × 1 multiplexers required are ________.
questions.solution_text:
Solution
(d)
The Boolean function F is on 4 variables. To implement 4 variable Boolean function a 16 × 1 multiplexer is required.
To release 16 × 1 MUX, number of 2 × 1 multiplexers required are 16 – 1 = 15.

questions.question_text: For a flip-flop with provisions for preset and clear, which of the following options is correct?
questions.question_html: For a flip-flop with provisions for preset and clear, which of the following options is correct?

A.text: A.Preset and clear operations are performed simultaneously
A.html: Preset and clear operations are performed simultaneously

questions.solution_text:
Solution
(d)
The preset input drives the flip-flop to a set state while the clear input drives it to a reset state.
Hence, both are disabled or only one is enabled at a time.
questions.solution_html:
Solution

(d)
The preset input drives the flip-flop to a set state while the clear input drives it to a reset state.
Hence, both are disabled or only one is enabled at a time.
